related.title: IndexedDB：版本升級與交易原子性
related.titleEn: IndexedDB: schema upgrades and transaction atomicity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付transfer-trace.csv、checksum與移轉後非法存取測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver transfer-trace.csv, checksums and post-transfer misuse tests.
related.difference: 建立唯一索引與五筆寫入，分別記錄request error、transaction abort與complete。
related.differenceEn: Define a unique index and five writes; log request error, transaction abort and complete separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
移轉ArrayBuffer讓送端失去原緩衝使用權；structured clone複製語意與transfer所有權語意不同。
教學基準：1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B；對照：2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B。

schema修改在versionchange交易中執行；交易abort應撤回整批寫入，舊連線可能阻擋升級。
教學基準：20+0 = 20 rows；對照：20+5 = 25 rows。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Transferring an ArrayBuffer removes sender access to its storage; structured-clone copying and transfer ownership are distinct semantics.
Teaching baseline: 1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B; comparison: 2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B.

Schema changes occur in versionchange transactions; abort rolls back the transaction and old connections can block upgrades.
Teaching baseline: 20+0 = 20 rows; comparison: 20+5 = 25 rows.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: npm lockfile：相依解析與可重現安裝
related.titleEn: npm lockfiles: dependency resolution and repeatable installation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付transfer-trace.csv、checksum與移轉後非法存取測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver transfer-trace.csv, checksums and post-transfer misuse tests.
related.difference: 解析package.json與lockfile，列出直接/間接相依、版本、integrity與來源registry。
related.differenceEn: Parse manifest and lockfile, listing direct/transitive dependencies, versions, integrity and registry.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
移轉ArrayBuffer讓送端失去原緩衝使用權；structured clone複製語意與transfer所有權語意不同。
教學基準：1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B；對照：2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B。

package範圍與lockfile解析結果不同；npm ci要求manifest與lock一致並採凍結安裝，不替你猜新解析。
教學基準：2+1+2 = 5 edges_or_nodes；對照：2+1+1 = 4 edges_or_nodes。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Transferring an ArrayBuffer removes sender access to its storage; structured-clone copying and transfer ownership are distinct semantics.
Teaching baseline: 1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B; comparison: 2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B.

Version ranges differ from lockfile resolutions; npm ci requires manifest-lock consistency and installs a frozen resolution rather than choosing a new one.
Teaching baseline: 2+1+2 = 5 edges_or_nodes; comparison: 2+1+1 = 4 edges_or_nodes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
